## Description

Lifts non-linear macroeconomic and return state-space dynamics into linear dynamical spaces using Koopman operator dictionaries, applying Model Predictive Control to optimize tactical asset allocation.

## Where it may fit

Macro regime shifts, multi-asset tactical allocation, non-linear return trajectory forecasting.

## Vehicles

Global Macro Hedge Funds, Quantitative Multi-Asset Desks.

## Required data

Multi-variable macro indicator series, asset volatility matrices, historical return panels.

## Caveats

Observable dictionary expansion requires L1 regularization to prevent overfitting in macro control loops.
